title: Decodability is Not Causality: Dissociating Probe Readouts from Behavioral Drivers via SAE Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2609.18080v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear probes can decode safety-relevant concepts such as truthfulness from language-model activations, but probe accuracy may show only decodability, not that the features the probe weights causally drive model behavior. We demonstrate that this gap cannot be closed from the geometry of probe weights alone: the features geometrically aligned with probe direction need not be the ones the model uses, so causal relevance requires intervention. We introduce a feature-level diagnostic that decomposes a deployed True/False probe into sparse-autoencoder (SAE) features, ranks those features by both probe alignment and by gradient sensitivity of the model's behavior, and ablates the resulting shared, probe-only, and random feature sets under a coherence gate. translated_title: 可解码性不等于因果性：通过SAE分解将探针读出与行为驱动因素分离
translated_abstract: 线性探针能够从语言模型激活中解码出诸如真实性等与安全相关的概念，但探针的准确率可能仅表明“可解码性”，而不能表明探针权重所对应的特征会因果性地驱动模型行为。我们证明，这一差距无法仅凭探针权重的几何结构来弥合：与探针方向几何对齐的特征未必是模型实际使用的特征，因此因果相关性必须通过干预实验来验证。我们引入了一种特征级诊断方法，将一个已部署的真/假（True/False）探针分解为稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征，依据探针对齐度和模型行为的梯度敏感度对特征进行排序，并在一致性门控下对由此得到的共享特征集、仅探针特征集以及随机特征集进行消融实验。在Buerger等人（2024）的真实性探针（TTPD）上，应用于Long等人（2025）设定的Gemma2-9B-Instruct指导性真实/欺骗情境中，两种排序仅呈现微弱重叠（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）分解的特征级诊断方法，证明探针的可解码性并不等于因果性——与探针方向几何对齐的特征与真正驱动模型行为的特征仅微弱重叠，因此因果相关性必须通过干预实验来确立。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an SAE-based feature-level diagnostic showing that decodability is not causality—features geometrically aligned with a probe's direction only weakly overlap with the features that actually drive model behavior, so causal relevance must be established through interventions.
